incidents.title: jupiter's socket proxy is too broad
incidents.summary: The socket proxy at tcp://10.0.11.120:2375 lets every GET under /containers/ through, so anyone who can reach it can read every container's environment, logs and files. Restrict who can connect (a firewall, or wollomatic's -allowfrom), or switch to a path-anchored allowlist like Cha Dash's compose preset.
incidents.resolves_when: Resolves when the proxy refuses container logs.

incidents.title: Frigate grants admin without a sign-in
incidents.summary: Cha Dash reads Frigate through a Frigate port (55000), which answers without a sign-in and makes anyone who can reach it an admin: they can change the config, restart Frigate and delete recordings.

suggested.label: Use the authenticated port
suggested.detail: Create a Frigate user with the viewer role, then point this instance at Frigate's authenticated port (8971) with that user.

incidents.resolves_when: Resolves when Cha Dash signs in to Frigate.

incidents.title: Traefik's dashboard has no auth
incidents.summary: Traefik's dashboard is routed without an auth middleware on traefik.lab.example. Its API asked for credentials, so only the dashboard's page is open today, but one router change could expose the API, and with it basic-auth password hashes.
incidents.resolves_when: Resolves when every dashboard router has an auth middleware.

incidents.title: PBS datastore is filling up
incidents.summary: Datastore main is 92% full (1.84 of 2 TB). At this rate it fills up in about 3 weeks.

causes.text: The daily prune job has been disabled since 14 Sep, so 38 snapshots are outside the retention policy.
iolinux's backup at 02:30 wrote 108 GB of new data, about 12 times a usual night. It has been running since yesterday 21:15.

suggested.label: Prune per policy
suggested.detail: Removes the 38 snapshots outside keep-daily 7 · weekly 4 · monthly 6, then runs garbage collection (about 20 minutes). Frees about 116 GB (92% → 86%). Pruned snapshots can't be restored.

alternatives.label: Re-enable the daily prune job
alternatives.detail: Prunes every night at 03:30 from now on. Undo turns it off again.

incidents.title: Karakeep's API changed
incidents.summary: Karakeep was updated to 0.31.0 at 09:02, and its stats endpoint now returns 404. Karakeep itself is up; bookmark counts show values as of 09:05.

causes.text: karakeep-web-1 was recreated with image 0.31.0 at 09:02.
This integration supports Karakeep up to 0.30.

suggested.label: Update the Karakeep integration
suggested.detail: Switches to the adapter for 0.31. Undo puts the previous one back.

alternatives.label: Roll Karakeep back to 0.30.2
alternatives.detail: Redeploys the karakeep stack on pvedocker with the previous image.

incidents.resolves_when: Resolves when the integration can read Karakeep again.

incidents.title: Plex rejected its token
incidents.summary: Plex has answered 401 Unauthorized since 13:27. Plex itself is up; its tiles show values as of 13:27.

causes.text: The stored token stopped working at 13:27. It was probably revoked, by signing out all devices or changing the Plex password.
Plex's own HTTP check still passes, so the problem is the connection, not Plex.

suggested.label: Reconnect Plex
suggested.detail: Sign in with a Plex PIN, about 10 seconds. The new token goes into the vault.

incidents.title: jupiter-nas is running out of memory
incidents.summary: Memory is at 95% of 8 GB and there is no swap. If it fills up, the kernel will stop a process to free memory.

causes.text: debian-nas (LXC 100) grew from 0.5 GB to 3.1 GB since 11:40.
No swap is configured on jupiter-nas.

suggested.label: Restart debian-nas
suggested.detail: Restarts the LXC, which takes about 20 seconds. Cockpit and the shares it serves are unavailable meanwhile.

incidents.resolves_when: Resolves when memory stays below 85% for 10 minutes.

incidents.title: qBittorrent ran out of memory
incidents.summary: Restarted at 14:03, waiting for the VPN tunnel. Sonarr and Radarr can't download until it's back.

causes.text: Memory grew from 1.1 GiB to the 4 GiB limit in 25 minutes.
About 20 torrents were downloading at the time.

suggested.label: Raise the memory limit to 6 GiB
suggested.detail: Unraid recreates binhex-qbittorrentvpn with the new limit, about 2 minutes. Downloads pause meanwhile.

incidents.resolves_when: Resolves when the memory limit is raised, or after 24 hours without another OOM kill.
